findings: ESRF Fe3C_up_p19 workbook has 20 states labelled p0-p19, including p0 at 0 GPa with stored volume 163.40230309104 A3. This is not identified as an EOS fit V0 and is not assigned to any published fit.
The workbook compression volumes differ materially from final Table S1; the first pressure-state volume is 153.6255042696 versus published 152.98 A3.

The Origin diffraction project has ten finite states from 1.8 to 22.6 GPa, with small but real changes relative to the final table (maximum absolute volume difference 0.04 A3). Its other allocated rows are blank/missing, not additional observations. No ambient point is present.
APS EOS workbooks contain separate lower-pressure series and processing variants; neither file name nor zero-pressure row establishes that a series supplied the final three ESRF fits.
No new fit, pressure recalibration, replacement observation, uncertainty convention or published coefficient was inferred.
